snippet.title: Miller's Fantasy: PARTY | Official Deluxe gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
ADD Miller's Fantasy to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081640/Millers_Fantasy_PARTY/

Miller's Fantasy PARTY - Deluxe is getting closer to its release, scheduled for May of this year!
We've decided to present the new features, including:

- New levels
- New characters
- English voice acting
- New endings
- New story
- New secrets
Stay tuned and add Miller's Fantasy Party to your Steam wishlist!
